concept.title: Hunt in the Drowned Fen
concept.logline: On fog-bound, mysterious Galorvale, you scour every corner to recover the seed relics and restore the Stilt Lookout.
concept.source_prompt: Swamp Fen. swamp marsh bog fen adventure The hunt
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Reedwater Camp and becomes the one who brings the Stilt Lookout back to life.

4 hostiles roam Hunt in the Drowned Fen. Close in and strike with E.
The land is safe again. The bounty is yours.

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: So you've come to Reedwater Camp at last. I am Elder Wren. On fog-bound, mysterious Galorvale, you scour every corner to recover the seed relics and restore the Stilt Lookout.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: Back again. Reedwater Camp is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: Go to Heron Jetty, then Woodcutter Camp. Whatever still remembers Hunt in the Drowned Fen is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: They say Reedwater Camp was built on what was left of an older place. Eerie, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: Heron Jetty: Heron Jetty: a dock on the way out from Reedwater Camp.

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Hunt in the Drowned Fen back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Elder Wren
nodes.text: Woodcutter Camp: Woodcutter Camp: a camp on the way out from Reedwater Camp.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Scout
nodes.text: Bram the Scout circles your feet, then looks toward Heron Jetty as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Scout
nodes.text: Bram the Scout hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Scout
nodes.text: It turns toward Heron Jetty. Heron Jetty: a dock on the way out from Reedwater Camp.

nodes.speaker: Thorn Wolf
nodes.text: The thorn wolf watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Thorn Wolf 2
nodes.text: The thorn wolf 2 watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Thorn Wolf 3
nodes.text: The thorn wolf 3 watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Reedwater Camp. Piet the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Hunt in the Drowned Fen that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Woodcutter Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.
